about: TEST ground truth of a synthetic IFC fixture (fictitious building, not a real project). Written by fixtures/generators/ifc/demo_hotel.py from fixtures/generators/ifc/spec/test.yaml together with the model, so it states what the file contains: every GlobalId, STEP instance id and verbatim STEP line (the excerpt) that an extractor must find. It is not an expected app output: which values may be stored is decided by the guardrails and the closed gates.
